title: 9tz.4: TantivySearchIndex struct + impl
description:
What: Implement TantivySearchIndex in crates/reader/src/search/mod.rs.

Algorithm:
1. Define schema builder function build_schema() -> tantivy::schema::Schema:
   - message_id: STORED (no indexing)
   - newsgroup: TEXT | STORED (single group; stored per-assignment)
   - article_num: FAST (u64, for NNTP result translation)
   - subject: TEXT | STORED
   - from_header: TEXT | STORED
   - date_ts: INDEXED | FAST | STORED (u64 unix timestamp)
   - body_text: TEXT (not stored, just indexed)

2. pub struct TantivySearchIndex { inner: Arc<SearchIndexInner> }
   struct SearchIndexInner { index: tantivy::Index, reader: tantivy::IndexReader, writer: tokio::sync::Mutex<tantivy::IndexWriter>, schema: tantivy::schema::Schema, config: SearchConfig }

3. impl TantivySearchIndex:
   a. pub fn open(config: &SearchConfig) -> Result<Option<Self>, SearchError>:
      - If config.index_dir.is_none() return Ok(None) (search disabled)
      - std::fs::create_dir_all(path)?
      - Open or create with error handling
      - writer = index.writer(50_000_000)? (50 MB buffer)
      - reader = index.reader()?
      - Return Ok(Some(Self { inner: Arc::new(SearchIndexInner { ... }) }))
   
   b. pub fn open_in_memory() -> Result<Self, SearchError>:
      - Use tantivy::Index::create_in_ram(schema) for tests
   
   c. pub async fn index_article(&self, message_id: &str, newsgroup: &str, article_num: u64, subject: &str, from: &str, date_str: &str, body_bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), SearchError>:
      - Parse date_str via httpdate or simple RFC 2822 parse; fallback to 0 on error
      - Truncate body_bytes to config.body_index_max_bytes (100 KiB default)
      - Convert body to UTF-8 lossy
      - let doc = tantivy::doc!( ... )
      - let writer = self.inner.writer.lock().await
      - writer.add_document(doc)?
      - (No commit here; commit happens in a separate periodic task or after each batch)
   
   d. pub async fn commit(&self) -> Result<(), SearchError>:
      - let mut writer = self.inner.writer.lock().await
      - writer.commit()?
   
   e. pub async fn search_in_group(&self, group: &str, query_str: &str, max_results: usize, max_query_len: usize) -> Result<Vec<u64>, SearchError>:
      - Validate query_str.len() <= max_query_len
      - Build QueryParser over [subject, from_header, body_text] fields
      - Use parse_query_lenient() (never panic)
      - Add newsgroup filter: newsgroup:group AND (parsed query)
      - searcher = self.inner.reader.searcher()
      - Execute with TopDocs::with_limit(max_results)
      - Return Vec<u64> of article_num values from stored fields

Defensive rules:
- All tantivy errors wrapped in SearchError::Tantivy
- Query too long → SearchError::QueryTooLong BEFORE calling tantivy
- parse_query_lenient() used (never panics on bad syntax)
- Body truncated BEFORE tantivy sees it (SearchConfig.body_index_max_bytes)
- date parse failure logs warning, uses 0 (don't reject article)
- index_article is infallible from the caller's perspective (errors are logged)

No unsafe. No unwrap() in production paths.
